mapper.sql: SELECT ua.user_id,atr.tag_id, SUM((CASE ua.action_type WHEN 7 THEN 1 WHEN 2 THEN 3 WHEN 3 THEN 5 WHEN 4 THEN 8 WHEN 5 THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) / (1 + GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY,ua.action_time,NOW()),0) / 7.0)) AS score FROM user_action ua JOIN article_tag_relation atr ON ua.article_id=atr.article_id JOIN article_info a ON a.article_id=ua.article_id AND a.status=1 AND a.deleted=0 WHERE ua.action_time > DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND ua.user_id=#{userId} GROUP BY ua.user_id,atr.tag_id HAVING score > 0
mapper.update: INSERT INTO user_tag_preference(user_id,tag_id,score,update_time) SELECT p.user_id,p.tag_id,p.score,NOW() FROM () p ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE score=VALUES(score),update_time=VALUES(update_time)
mapper.select: SELECT p.tag_id FROM () p ORDER BY p.score DESC,p.tag_id LIMIT #{limit}
